short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa matar
short.answer: This is rain.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-ghurfati sariir
short.answer: In the room there is a bed.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii. asmaʿu bi-udhunii. (2 marks)
short.answer: I write with my hand. I hear with my ear.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa ʿinda l-baab
short.answer: I am at the door.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why poems help us when learning a language. (2 marks)
short.answer: The rhythm and rhyme help us to remember words and to practise pronunciation.
short.working: 1 mark for memory and 1 mark for pronunciation.

short.q: Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii
short.answer: I wash my face.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: unadhdhifu asnaanii
short.answer: I clean my teeth.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain how drawing and labelling help you to remember new words. (2 marks)
short.answer: The picture shows the meaning and writing the label practises the spelling.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Translate into English: abii yaʿmalu
short.answer: My father works.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ukhtii jamiila
short.answer: My sister is beautiful.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write the Arabic sounds for 'two hands' and 'two legs' and give the meaning of each ending. (3 marks)
short.answer: yadaani (two hands) and rijlaani (two legs). The ending -aani means two.
short.working: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for the ending.

short.q: Describe how you can make flashcards for the days of the week. (3 marks)
short.answer: Cut cards; write the Arabic day on the front; write the English name and sound on the back; decorate and display in order.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step.

short.q: Translate into English: akhii yalʿabu
short.answer: My brother plays.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four weather features in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), riih (wind), matar (rain).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Give three tips for neat handwriting with good word spacing. (3 marks)
short.answer: Leave a gap about one letter wide between words; keep letters in a word joined smoothly; write on the baseline; put dots neatly.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid tip.

short.q: Translate into English: kayfa haaluki?
short.answer: How are you? (to a girl)
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write two describing words in Arabic sounds with their meanings, one for a masculine and one for a feminine item. (3 marks)
short.answer: kabiir (big) for a masculine word and kabiira (big) for a feminine word.
short.working: 1 mark for each form and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: marhaban yaa Ahmad
short.answer: Hello, Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
short.answer: How is the weather today?
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four weather words in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example shams (sun), matar (rain), riih (wind), sahaab (clouds).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Write the seven days of the week in Arabic sounds, in order. (4 marks)
short.answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt.
short.working: 4 marks for all seven in order; 3 for five or six; 2 for three or four; 1 for one or two.

short.q: Read these words and write their sounds in English letters with meanings: مَرْحَبًا and شُكْرًا. (4 marks)
short.answer: mar-ha-ban (hello) and shuk-ran (thank you).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct reading and 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: aakulu l-aruzza
short.answer: I eat rice.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'I eat bread and I drink milk.' (2 marks)
short.answer: aakulu l-khubza wa ashrabu l-haliiba. I eat bread and I drink milk.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿindii hadiyya
short.answer: I have a gift.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: nahnu narqusu
short.answer: We dance.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab
short.answer: The chair is at the door.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: hal ʿindaka hafla?
short.answer: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Spell the word الخميس by naming its letters in order. (3 marks)
short.answer: alif, laam, khaa, miim, yaa, siin.
short.working: 3 marks for all six letters in order; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

short.q: Sort these words into items and position words: kitaab, ʿalaa, taawila, taHta. (4 marks)
short.answer: Items: kitaab (book), taawila (table). Position words: ʿalaa (on), taHta (under).
short.working: 1 mark for each word placed correctly.

short.q: Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira
short.answer: The table is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: lii ʿaynaani
short.answer: I have two eyes.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ
short.answer: I am in Grade 4.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Put these words in order and translate: الْحَفْلَةَ / أُحِبُّ / أَنَا. (3 marks)
short.answer: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ. I like the party.
short.working: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: ashrabu sh-shaaya
short.answer: I drink tea.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give two tips for pronouncing Arabic greetings correctly. (2 marks)
short.answer: Listen to the teacher first and copy; say long vowels for longer than short vowels; practise the throat sounds kh and ʿ.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

short.q: Translate into English: ukhtii taqraʾu
short.answer: My sister reads.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii
short.answer: I see with my eye.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka
short.answer: The friends eat the cake.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three examples of non-verbal cues you could use when reciting a poem about weather. (3 marks)
short.answer: Lifting arms for the sun; wiggling fingers downwards for rain; smiling at the last line.
short.working: 1 mark for each cue that matches a word.

short.q: Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks)
short.answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
short.working: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.

short.q: Write five words about weather and the environment in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Explain why your family members are important to you. Give two examples of roles. (3 marks)
short.answer: They love and care for us. For example parents work, cook and pay for school; grandparents share stories and advice; children help at home.
short.working: 1 mark for love and care, 2 marks for two correct roles.

short.q: Write five weather or environment words in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: baytii kabiir
short.answer: My house is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three ways of taking care of your body. (3 marks)
short.answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well; play outdoors.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way.

short.q: Say where the pen is if it is in the bag. Write the sentence in English letters and translate it. (3 marks)
short.answer: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba. The pen is in the bag.
short.working: 1 mark for the item, 1 mark for the position word fii, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks)
short.answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.

short.q: Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks)
short.answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
short.working: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.

short.q: Write five parts of the body in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), wajh (face), shaʿr (hair), ʿayn (eye), udhun (ear).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi hafla
short.answer: This is a party.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Name three rooms of the house in Arabic (English letters) with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 3.

short.q: Translate into English: atakallamu bi-famii
short.answer: I speak with my mouth.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: uhibbu l-ʿasiira
short.answer: I like juice.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four foods or drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa uhibbu l-hafla
short.answer: I like the party.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write a short speech of at least four sentences about your house in Arabic sounds (English letters). Give the meaning. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. ismii Amina. haadhaa baytii. fii baytii matbakh. shukran li-istimaaʿikum. (Peace be upon you. My name is Amina. This is my house. In my house there is a kitchen. Thank you for listening.)
short.working: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the topic sentence, 1 mark for a detail and 1 mark for the closing thanks.

short.q: Write three instructions about the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: irfaʿ yadaka (raise your hand), ilmis anfaka (touch your nose), aghmiD ʿaynayka (close your eyes).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kursiyyu jadiid
short.answer: The chair is new.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis
short.answer: Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila
short.answer: The book is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give two reasons why reading is important. (2 marks)
short.answer: It helps us to learn new words and information, and it gives us enjoyment.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

short.q: Give two reasons why we should take care of household items. (2 marks)
short.answer: They last longer and save money, and keeping them in the right place keeps us safe.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

short.q: Write two Arabic sentences in sounds about a celebration and translate them. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example haadhihi hafla. This is a party. ʿindii hadiyya. I have a gift.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each translation.

short.q: Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks)
short.answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid quality.

short.q: Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks)
short.answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
short.working: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Give three things you can do to listen attentively. (3 marks)
short.answer: Look at the speaker; do not talk while someone is speaking; think about the topic; listen for words you know; ask a question at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid behaviour, up to 3.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'The weather is cold.' (2 marks)
short.answer: al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks)
short.answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
short.working: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

short.q: Translate into English: ashrabu l-maa'a
short.answer: I drink water.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks)
short.answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct match.

short.q: Explain how the weather affects our daily life. Give two examples. (3 marks)
short.answer: Rain helps crops to grow; hot sun makes us look for shade; we choose our clothes by the weather.
short.working: 1 mark for the idea and 1 mark for each example.

short.q: Explain the three reading strategies: decoding, cues and word spacing. (3 marks)
short.answer: Decoding: sounding out each letter and mark. Cues: using pictures and the sentence to guess. Word spacing: looking at the spaces to see where words begin and end.
short.working: 1 mark for each strategy.

short.q: Describe how to carry out a dictation of the days of the week in pairs. (3 marks)
short.answer: One learner says a day; the other repeats it, says the sounds and writes the letters from right to left; they check and correct together.
short.working: 1 mark for saying the day, 1 mark for writing and 1 mark for checking.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa baytii
short.answer: This is my house.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Rearrange the words and translate: الْعَصِيرَ / أَشْرَبُ. (2 marks)
short.answer: أَشْرَبُ الْعَصِيرَ. I drink juice.
short.working: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿindii akh wa ukht
short.answer: I have a brother and a sister.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: azraʿu shajara
short.answer: I plant a tree.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i
short.answer: The sun is in the sky.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana
short.answer: The key is in the cupboard.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-maa'u mufiid
short.answer: Water is useful (good for you).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks)
short.answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
short.working: 1 mark for each valid check.

short.q: Give two polite words for interrupting or inviting someone to speak, with meanings. (2 marks)
short.answer: ʿafwan (excuse me) and tafaddal (please, go ahead).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with meaning.

short.q: Give three points you would check when you assess a friend's reading. (3 marks)
short.answer: Words pronounced correctly; smooth reading without stops; heavy and throat sounds clear; no word skipped.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point.

short.q: Explain why you should copy sounds carefully when learning Arabic words. (2 marks)
short.answer: A small change in a sound can change the meaning, and careful copying makes you clear to the listener.
short.working: 1 mark for change of meaning and 1 mark for being understood.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub
short.answer: On the table there is a cup.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a
short.answer: How beautiful the environment is!
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain what it means to read with fluency and give two tips for reading fluently. (3 marks)
short.answer: Fluency means reading smoothly at a steady speed with correct words. Tips: put a finger under each word; practise at slow and normal speed.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for each tip.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah
short.answer: I am well, thanks be to God.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Spell the word باب by naming the letters in order, and give its meaning. (3 marks)
short.answer: baa, alif, baa. It means door.
short.working: 1 mark for the letters, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks)
short.answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: A four-line poem says: ʿaynii taraa, udhunii tasmaʿu, anfii yashummu, famii yatakallamu. Give the meaning of the first line and say what the poem is about. (3 marks)
short.answer: My eye sees. The poem says what a part of the body does: the eye sees, the ear hears, the nose smells and the mouth speaks.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning of the line and 2 marks for the poem's idea.

short.q: State the job of each part of a speech: opening, middle and closing. (3 marks)
short.answer: Opening: greet and say who you are. Middle: give the information. Closing: thank the audience.
short.working: 1 mark for each part.

short.q: Write one Arabic sentence about today's weather in sounds and translate it. (2 marks)
short.answer: For example al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Name the four marks (harakat) that show short vowels or no vowel and say what each one shows. (4 marks)
short.answer: fatHa gives a, kasra gives i, Damma gives u, and sukuun shows no vowel.
short.working: 1 mark for each mark and its meaning.

short.q: Name three things that make Arabic writing different from English writing. (3 marks)
short.answer: It is written from right to left; it has no capital letters; most letters join and change shape; short vowels are shown with marks.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid difference.

short.q: Say what a vocabulary bank is and how you can make one from a poem. (3 marks)
short.answer: A vocabulary bank keeps new words for later. Pick out the words from the poem and write each with its sound, meaning and a picture on cards.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 2 marks for the method.

short.q: Explain the difference between a direct question and an inferential question. Give one example of each about a text on breakfast. (4 marks)
short.answer: A direct question has its answer in the text, for example 'What does she drink?' An inferential question needs clues, for example 'Is it morning?'.
short.working: 1 mark for each definition and 1 mark for each suitable example.

short.q: Write five household items in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.
